jobs.prompt: Clean flat 2D strategic business documentary illustration in the established How They Took Over channel identity. Modern vector-like artwork, simple recognizable people and company environments, crisp products and technology, high readability, clear silhouettes, controlled shading, clean high-contrast composition, visually intuitive strategy diagrams, timelines, maps, market competition, business flywheels and growth systems. Energetic but professional. FILL THE ENTIRE FRAME edge to edge, no letterbox, no pillarbox, no black bars. Any on-image label, badge, sign, or diagram text must sit fully inside a 10 percent margin from every edge. Never place text flush with the top, bottom, or sides of the frame. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, not painterly, not stock imagery. Accent this title with a graphite, bone, and cobalt palette; keep the same clean flat 2D construction. Horizontal 16:9 frame. Not photorealistic, not a photograph, not cinematic photography, not 3D, not Pixar, not anime, not manga, not watercolor, not oil painting, not hyper-detailed, not a superhero comic, not photomontage, not DSLR, not realistic skin texture. NO swastika, NO Nazi flag, NO SS runes, NO armbands, NO camps, NO gore, NO celebrity photoreal faces. No readable paragraphs of body copy, no watermarks, no captions overlaid on the frame unless the scene names a short on-screen label. Not a 3D corporate animation, not a stock-photo slideshow, not a logo-vs-logo poster, not a photoreal product shot. ONE idea in the frame. ONE oversized focal object large in the middle, high contrast, never a faint mark. Unique staging this still owns. Named lighting (warm lamp, cool window, tungsten, night orange). Empty air on one side. Fill the entire frame. Recurring people keep the exact same cartoon face and ALWAYS-clothes from the lock; expression matches the action. Costume-locked extras when the beat needs a shopper or clerk. No cluttered infographic. No generic filing-table wallpaper. No logos. No readable paragraphs. Same extra every time: adult in a plain cream polo and headset, simple flat face, no logos. LOCATION catalog_wall (same set): tall wall of blank vinyl sleeves, no letters, cool fluorescent. Palette: sand, ivory, slate. Costume-locked extras from the bibles (same sweater, smock, hard hat every time). Same flat-vector construction. No photoreal faces. No generic gray clerks.
